texts: One dance, 52 joints, any humanoid skeleton: how three.ws retargets motion to rigs from other tools

One 9.87 second dance clip, authored once on a 52-joint skeleton, now plays in step on Mixamo, Ready Player Me and other avatars it was not made for. The write-up shows how bone names are matched, why a matching name is not enough, and where the retargeter refuses: three.ws/rig-doctor
